hook: A toddler runs laughing through the house, hugging a stuffed animal, past his usual bedtime
title: Bedtime rule: keep running
caption:
The rule in this house: stay up late, but only while you keep running. 😄
The toddler laps the living room and hallway, stuffed animal in his arms, giggling the whole way.
Every family finds its own bedtime tricks. Would this work at your house?
Save this for a bedtime idea and follow for more real parenting moments.
